title: Social Media & Content Production — source-grounded editorial audit
source_audit_result: 2 substantive text-based creative production workflows discovered + 3 unclassified MP4 source files

findings.working_title: ELP — English Listening Podcast Content System
verified_from_document: Master prompt for a 10–12-minute YouTube English-listening podcast, designed for Gen Z/young adults at A2+–B1.
Defines a two-host conversation between Kate and Jake, with American English, natural conversational structure, constructive debate and a restrained romantic dynamic.
Has structured input fields for topic, tone, debate mode, creative direction, optional research sources and quality controls.
References ElevenLabs as an intended AI voice production method; does not prove paid account, rendered audio or deployed provider integration.
Includes an example extended 'overthinking' conversation script and visual art prompt material; these are source outputs, not evidence of a published channel.
findings.owner_attribution: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED; document is in user's connected Drive, do not assert sole original authorship or delivered media
findings.defensible_copy: Tài liệu quy trình xây dựng nội dung podcast học tiếng Anh bằng AI: xác định người nghe, trình độ, giọng điệu, cấu trúc đối thoại và chuẩn đầu ra.
not_claimable: A running YouTube channel with measured view count
Original voice performances by the owner

editorial_judgment.relationship_to_existing_lanes: ELP overlaps AI & Learning but is best represented primarily in Content Production as a workflow proof; 'Happiness' belongs Creative Production archive; video files stay unclassified. No duplicate project counts with Music, Event or Game.
editorial_judgment.ranking: ELP is the strongest presently evidenced content-system concept. It is a supporting artifact until an actual finished episode is linked/verified.
editorial_judgment.narrative_structure: Audience problem → creative brief → storyboard / script architecture → review criteria → real deliverable (only when verified).
editorial_judgment.needed_publication_proof: At least one final audio/video sample and explicit owner role/permission for any public product case study; the process document can be described in general terms without posting private scripts.
editorial_judgment.constraint: Do not imply the entire 181k-character document was independently produced by owner; sources and authorship differ.
